banners.tagline: Folders of SKILL.md instructions every harness loads on demand — the universal artifact

minimum.v: semver + contentSha256 — spec has no version
skillDir + entry + files[] for copy installs

banners.why: SKILL.md ships 6 spec fields and no version — the registry owns identity, seal and per-harness copies.
banners.rowSummary: Overlay on three, copy-as-is on Pi — one spec-pure SKILL.md, only vendor metadata keys differ.
banners.update: OpenCode's catalog self-updates; Codex re-copy + restart, Claude drops manual, Pi packaged via pi update. agentreg.lock pins urn→ver→sha.

banners.tagline: Markdown files that become /slash-command prompts — legacy everywhere, absorbed by skills

minimum.v: semver + sha — nothing versions a command

banners.why: One markdown shape drops as-is into four prompts dirs; the record adds identity, hash, per-harness paths.
banners.rowSummary: Copy-as-is ×4 — the only row where one file lands unchanged everywhere; Codex deprecated + user-only, Claude legacy.
banners.update: No auto-update anywhere: manual file replaces; Pi refreshes prompts only inside packages. agentreg.lock is the sole version pin.

banners.tagline: Helper agents with their own prompt, model and tool scope — Claude md is the canonical shape

minimum.v: required frontmatter pair in every dialect
tool scope, model, memory, isolation flags
codex project layer inert until trusted

banners.why: Claude md is canonical; Codex wants TOML, OpenCode mode/perms — record stores the neutral form + translations.
banners.rowSummary: Claude md is canonical; Codex + OpenCode translate frontmatter; Pi has no core surface (example extension only).
banners.update: Nothing self-updates: manual file edits; plugin-bundled agents ride plugin updates (Claude). Lockfile pins what nothing else versions.

banners.tagline: Lifecycle-event handlers — Claude-shape JSON for two harnesses, generated TypeScript for two

minimum.v: codegen: oc TS plugin · pi pi.on() ext
review — hooks run code, can block tools

banners.why: Hooks run code (tier=review): two harnesses take JSON, two need generated TS — store spec, not the codegen.
banners.rowSummary: Same JSON drops into Claude and Codex (trust-gated); OpenCode and Pi translate spec into generated TypeScript modules.
banners.update: Nothing self-updates: Claude/Codex settings static; OpenCode/Pi update only when codegen'd plugin ships on npm — lockfile gates every bump.

banners.tagline: Bundles of skills, hooks, agents and MCP — one artifact, four different package formats

minimum.v: review if hooks/MCP ship in bundle

banners.why: Only Codex loads the bundle natively — dual-emit Claude's manifest, decompose to npm for OpenCode and Pi.
banners.rowSummary: Every harness repackages: Claude dual-manifest, Codex .codex-plugin overlay, OpenCode and Pi npm adapter packages.
banners.update: The only self-updating row: Claude marketplace auto-update, codex plugin upgrade, opencode/pi plugin update — lockfile pins the drift.

banners.tagline: External tool servers over stdio or HTTP — the second universal payload, four config dialects

minimum.v: claude/pi JSON · codex TOML · oc v1/v2

banners.why: Renders as Claude/Pi JSON, Codex TOML, OpenCode's two key shapes — transport + sha256 + auth boundary.
banners.rowSummary: JSON copies as-is into Claude and Pi; Codex needs TOML, OpenCode v1/v2 JSON — one record, four emissions.
banners.update: No update flow anywhere — manual re-add (Claude entries replace, never merge); lockfile is the only cross-harness version pin.

banners.tagline: Language servers bundled into Claude plugins for code-aware tools — one consumer of four

minimum.v: must ride a plugin bundle; alt lspServers

banners.why: Only Claude loads LSP — the record marks three harnesses unsupported and wraps the server in a plugin bundle.
banners.rowSummary: translate/no-surface ×3 — Claude only, via a plugin-wrapped .lsp.json; Codex, OpenCode and Pi have no LSP surface.
banners.update: Rides the parent plugin — Claude plugin auto-update covers it; others need supported=false. The lockfile tracks the plugin version.

banners.tagline: Custom agent tools as code — no drop-in file; OpenCode and Pi load them as TypeScript plugins

minimum.v: review — code runs in-process, full OS
npm pkg @version + sha; no loose .ts pin

banners.why: Two harnesses load tools via generated code; two have no surface — record keeps a neutral spec + review tier.
banners.rowSummary: Claude's tools live in SDK code and Codex has none — only OpenCode and Pi, via codegen'd TypeScript.
banners.update: Updates ride npm plugins on OpenCode and Pi; Claude (SDK code) and Codex (none) have nothing to update — lockfile pins the generated pkg.

banners.tagline: The custom status bar: a script Claude feeds session JSON; Pi reaches it via theme JSON

minimum.v: strict JSON; name must equal filename
pi theme fields; claude script variant

banners.why: Claude takes a script + settings key, Pi theme JSON — record carries both forms and marks two unsupported.
banners.rowSummary: Script copies as-is into Claude; Pi gets a theme-JSON overlay; Codex and OpenCode document no status-line surface.
banners.update: Claude's script updates by file replace; Pi themes ride pi update when packaged, manual as drops — no update channel; lockfile pins.

banners.tagline: Permission rules, sandboxes and trust gates — emitted from the record's declared requirements
banners.why: Policy is derived not dropped: each gated harness gets a dialect of the declared requirements; Pi has no gate.
banners.rowSummary: Derived, not installed: Claude allow-rules, Codex .rules verbatim, OpenCode permission effects — Pi runs ungated.
banners.update: No auto-updates: managed keys admin-only (Claude), admins pin requirements.toml (Codex), orgs push oc policies — registry supplies diffs.
